name: fullscreen_shops
_comment: R8 wave 4: fullscreen (1920x1080) captures of the spaceport, outfitter, shipyard, trade center, mission BBS and bar at Earth with stock data and a stock Shuttle (pilot w4_fs). "prefs" turns RunInAWindow off for this run only; the run restores the prefs after quitting. Each venue is tried by its first letter (K1: spaceport hotkeys), then Escape. Wave 5: title_wait 12000 (in fullscreen the window appears before the title screen is ready; the first try pressed o too early).
